display.title: Lech Lecha: Avraham Avinu's Army of One
display.summary_short: Avraham Avinu rescues Lot from five powerful kings with only Eliezer at his side. Rashi's secret of the 318 soldiers teaches that with Hashem we need no great army.
display.summary_long: A parsha talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given at the start of 5751, the year of wonders. Uncle Yossi tells how, in Parshas Lech Lecha, Avraham Avinu heard that his nephew Lot had been captured in the war of the kings and went out to fight five powerful kings with only his faithful servant Eliezer. The Torah speaks of 318 soldiers, but Rashi explains that 318 is the numerical value of the name Eliezer, which means 'my G-d is my help'. As Tehillim says, some trust in chariots and horses, but we mention the name of Hashem. The Torah is a lesson for today: in every generation enemies rise against the Jewish people and Hashem saves us. Children in Tzivos Hashem are encouraged to listen carefully to the parsha in shul this Shabbos, bring friends and relatives along, and look forward to the greatest miracle of all, the coming of Moshiach.
display.lesson: With firm trust in Hashem we do not need to count soldiers or weapons; Hashem is the One who helps us.
